story-ashok-leyland-ltd.title: Engine R&D Division — SANPAR Industries
story-ashok-leyland-ltd.description: SANPAR success story: Engine R&D Division, Ashok Leyland Ltd, Hosur - Emissions testing accuracy achieved for ARAI-standard particulate measurement — a SANPAR Climatic Controller maintains the weighing room at exactly 22±1°C and 45±2% RH, enabling precise filter paper measurements.

story-excel-glass.title: Excel Glass — SANPAR Industries
story-excel-glass.description: SANPAR success story: Excel Glass, Allappuzha, Kerala - Blowholes in glass moulds eliminated entirely. SANPAR's XEROS dryer replaced a failing shell-and-tube system — cutting pressure drop in half (0.2 bar to 0.1 bar) while delivering India's largest refrigerated dryer from a domestic manufacturer.

story-gas-turbine-research-establishment.title: Gas Turbine Research Establishment (GTRE) — SANPAR Industries
story-gas-turbine-research-establishment.description: SANPAR success story: Gas Turbine Research Establishment (GTRE), Bangalore - Power consumption for turbine blade testing air supply reduced dramatically — by replacing a desiccant dryer (25% purge loss) with a custom SANPAR refrigerated system on a mobile trolley. Now used for India's most advanced gas turbine development programme.

story-hical-technologies.title: Hical Technologies Pvt. Ltd. — SANPAR Industries
story-hical-technologies.description: SANPAR success story: Hical Technologies Pvt. Ltd. - Vacuum potting environment stabilised at 23±2°C and 40±5% RH — eliminating pustule defects on inductors and achieving 100% yield on a previously inconsistent process.

story-hindustan-motors.title: Hindustan Motors — SANPAR Industries
story-hindustan-motors.description: SANPAR success story: Hindustan Motors, Calcutta - 6 compressors eliminated. ₹8.7 lakhs saved every month. Over ₹1 crore in annual savings — with zero production disruption during the changeover.

story-infosys-technologies-ltd.title: Infosys Technologies Ltd — SANPAR Industries
story-infosys-technologies-ltd.description: SANPAR success story: Infosys Technologies Ltd, Mysore - Laundry drying time at Infosys Mysore campus reduced significantly — a compact 11.50 CFM / 7 bar g system that solved a quality-of-life problem for thousands of resident employees.

story-jindal-steel-power-limited-raigarh.title: Jindal Steel & Power Limited — SANPAR Industries
story-jindal-steel-power-limited-raigarh.description: SANPAR success story: Jindal Steel & Power Limited, Raigarh - 6 large-capacity dryers deployed across Raigarh facility — protecting blast furnace operations from moisture-related damage and maintaining full production volumes with R407C eco-friendly refrigerant.

story-jmt-auto-ltd.title: JMT Auto Ltd — SANPAR Industries
story-jmt-auto-ltd.description: SANPAR success story: JMT Auto Ltd, Jamshedpur - CMM measurement accuracy restored to specification — and JMT Auto was so impressed, they ordered a second system for their Dharwad plant within months.
